title: Frequently asked questions
subtitle: In-depth questions and answers — from AI, AEO, GEO and SEO to design, domains, hosting, marketing, social media, support and more.
ctaText: Can't find your question? Contact us — we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

items.question: What does TripleZero iT do exactly?
items.answer: TripleZero iT combines webdesign, WordPress support, digital marketing, search visibility (AEO, GEO/local and SEO), design and hosting. We help brands get found faster, build better websites and grow in a measurable way.

items.question: How do I get started with TripleZero iT?
items.answer: Contact us or book an appointment. We run a short intake, review goals and stack, then prepare a concrete proposal with planning and KPIs.

items.question: Which types of businesses do you work with?
items.answer: We work with SMBs, scale-ups, ecommerce, agencies and international brands. That can be alongside an existing team, or as a full-service partner.

items.question: Do you only work in the Netherlands?
items.answer: No. We serve clients in the Benelux and internationally, with Dutch-language and English-language engagements.

items.question: What does a typical engagement look like?
items.answer: A typical engagement runs like this: intake → audit or scan → plan → sprint execution → measurement → optimization. You get clear milestones and reporting, so it is always clear where we stand.

items.question: Can I combine multiple services?
items.answer: Yes. Many clients combine webdesign + SEO + ads, or WordPress maintenance + hosting + security. We tailor the mix to your goals and budget.

items.question: How soon can you start?
items.answer: It depends on our capacity, but after approval we often start within a few business days. Urgent work — such as bugs, malware or downtime — is prioritized so we can pick it up as quickly as possible.

items.question: Do you work remote or on-site?
items.answer: We work primarily remote, with clear communication via email, chat and calls. On-site is available on request when the project needs it.

items.question: How does the team communicate progress?
items.answer: We keep you updated through regular updates, tickets or a dashboard where relevant, plus sprint or monthly reports with actions and results.

items.question: What do you need from us to start?
items.answer: To start, we need access to the website and hosting (if required), your goals, brand guidelines, analytics accounts and any existing tools. If something is missing, we help get it in place first.

items.question: Are your services a fit for startups?
items.answer: Yes. We scale from lean landing pages and AI scans to full growth setups, so the approach grows with you.

items.question: Who owns the work and accounts?
items.answer: Your domain, content, code repositories and ad accounts stay yours. At handover we deliver the files and documentation so everything remains under your control.

items.question: Can you take over or collaborate with existing vendors?
items.answer: Yes. We work smoothly alongside developers, marketers or agencies, or we take over maintenance and optimization without unnecessarily disrupting existing work.

items.question: What is an AI scan at TripleZero iT?
items.answer: An AI-readiness scan assesses how well your site can be found by classic search engines, AI answers and local or geographic search results (AEO, GEO, SEO and the technical foundations).

items.question: What does the AI scan measure exactly?
items.answer: The scan measures AEO signals, GEO/local visibility, SEO fundamentals, content structure, performance indicators and AI readiness. You receive scores and concrete improvement points.

items.question: How often should I run an AI scan?
items.answer: At minimum after major site changes or campaigns. For active brands we recommend periodic scans, for example each quarter, so you stay visible in search and AI results.

items.question: Does AI only help with content?
items.answer: No. AI also affects technical discoverability, structured data, internal linking, FAQ blocks and how brand information is summarized in AI answers.

items.question: Can you integrate AI into our workflow?
items.answer: Yes. We can use AI for content assistance, automation, chatbot or ticket flows, data connections and custom APIs around AI tools.

items.question: Does AI replace your strategic work?
items.answer: No. AI speeds up analysis and production, but strategy, brand voice and conversion decisions stay human and measurable.

items.question: Is AI content safe for SEO?
items.answer: Only with human review, unique insights and E-E-A-T. We avoid thin, generic text that harms rankings.

items.question: What is AI readiness for my brand?
items.answer: It is the degree to which your site, content and data are set up so AI systems can correctly cite, recommend and explain your brand.

items.question: Can you use AI agents in the dashboard?
items.answer: Yes. In the client portal you see AI agents for SEO, content, social and ads — including status and tasks.

items.question: Do you work with ChatGPT, Claude or other tools?
items.answer: We choose tools per use case. Governance matters: sources, fact-checking, brand guidelines and privacy, so AI use stays reliable.

items.question: Does AI help with support tickets?
items.answer: Yes, for triage and faster replies. Complex or sensitive cases are always escalated to a human teammate.

items.question: What does an AI engagement cost?
items.answer: It ranges from a free or entry-level AI scan to monthly AI and marketing retainers. After intake you receive a clear proposal.

items.question: How do I measure ROI of AI initiatives?
items.answer: Through KPIs such as traffic, leads, time saved, content output, ticket resolution and conversion. We define those upfront in the plan so results stay visible.

items.question: What is the difference between AEO, GEO and SEO?
items.answer: AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) focuses on AI answers. GEO (Geographic Search Engine Optimization) strengthens local and regional visibility in Maps, local packs and location-based search. SEO optimizes for classic search engines.

items.question: Why do AEO/GEO matter now?
items.answer: More searchers get answers via AI and also search locally (“near me”). Without AEO you miss AI citations; without GEO you miss local leads — even when classic SEO is solid.

items.question: How do you start an SEO engagement?
items.answer: We start with a technical audit, keyword and intent research, a content-gap analysis and a priority roadmap linked to your business KPIs.

items.question: How long until SEO results become visible?
items.answer: Technical wins can show quickly. Organic growth usually builds over weeks to months, depending on competition and how consistently we execute.

items.question: Do you also do local SEO?
items.answer: Yes. We work on Google Business Profile, local landing pages, NAP consistency, reviews and local content clusters so you are found better in your region.

items.question: What is technical SEO for you?
items.answer: Technical SEO covers crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, structured data, sitemap and robots, canonicals, internal linking and error cleanup — everything search engines need to understand the site well.

items.question: Do you help with content for SEO?
items.answer: Yes. We create briefs, outlines, blogs, landing pages and FAQs that match search intent and are structured in an AI-friendly way.

items.question: What is E-E-A-T and why does it matter?
items.answer: E-E-A-T stands for Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness and Trust. Strong E-E-A-T helps rankings and your brand’s credibility in AI summaries.

items.question: Do you do link building?
items.answer: Yes, ethically and relevantly: digital PR, partnerships and content assets. We do not use spammy link schemes.

items.question: Can you repair existing SEO damage?
items.answer: Yes. We repair damage after updates, toxic links, indexation problems or content cannibalization, then set a clean growth path.

items.question: How do you report SEO progress?
items.answer: Monthly or per sprint we report rankings, traffic, conversions, technical issues and next actions, so it is clear what we did and what comes next.

items.question: Does SEO work for ecommerce?
items.answer: Absolutely. We optimize product and category SEO, faceted navigation, reviews, structured data and content hubs around purchase intent.

items.question: Is SEO a one-off project or ongoing?
items.answer: The best results come from ongoing optimization. One-off audits help, but competitors do not stand still — that is why we keep measuring and adjusting.

items.question: Do you help with international SEO?
items.answer: Yes. We handle hreflang, market research per country or language, content localization and technical multi-locale setups.

items.question: Which advertising channels do you support?
items.answer: We support Google Ads, Meta (Facebook/Instagram), LinkedIn, and where relevant YouTube or retargeting — aligned to funnel and budget.

items.question: How do you determine the right advertising budget?
items.answer: We set the budget based on goals (leads or sales), CAC targets, market prices and a test phase. We start lean and scale what works.

items.question: What is your approach to Google Ads?
items.answer: We set a clear account structure, map search intent, add negative keywords, check landing-page fit, set up conversion tracking and optimize weekly.

items.question: Can you run Meta Ads for ecommerce?
items.answer: Yes. We run catalog and retargeting campaigns, test creatives and audiences, and optimize to improve ROAS.

items.question: How do you measure advertising success?
items.answer: We measure conversions, CPA/CAC, ROAS, lead quality and pipeline — not clicks alone. That way we optimize for results instead of volume.

items.question: What if tracking is wrong?
items.answer: Then we fix tagging (GTM, GA4 and pixels), consent mode where needed, and server-side options for more reliable data.

items.question: Do you also run B2B LinkedIn Ads?
items.answer: Yes. We use sharp targeting, lead-gen forms or landing pages and content that speaks to decision-makers.

items.question: How quickly will I see results from ads?
items.answer: Traffic can arrive immediately. Stable CPA or ROAS usually needs 2 to 6 weeks of learning and creative iteration.

items.question: Do you also create ad creatives?
items.answer: Yes. We create copy, visuals and test variants. Design and media creation can be included so campaigns do not wait on creatives.

items.question: Can ads and SEO reinforce each other?
items.answer: Absolutely. Search data from ads feeds SEO; strong organic pages lower CPA and raise Quality Score.

items.question: Do you manage existing ad accounts?
items.answer: Yes. We audit, restructure and optimize without unnecessarily starting over.

items.question: How do you prevent wasted ad budget?
items.answer: We prevent waste with negative keywords, audience exclusions, budget caps, geofencing, frequency control and quickly pausing underperformers.

items.question: Is remarketing still relevant?
items.answer: Yes, when it is privacy-compliant and paired with strong creatives and offers. It often remains the most efficient layer in the funnel.

items.question: Which design services do you offer?
items.answer: We offer logos, brand identity, business cards, letterhead, flyers, posters, stickers, magazines or brochures and digital visuals.

items.question: Which tools do you work in?
items.answer: We work in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign so files are print-ready and professionally interchangeable.

items.question: Do you deliver print-ready files?
items.answer: Yes. We deliver CMYK, bleed, crop marks and the right PDF/X export where needed, plus screen variants for digital use.

items.question: How does a logo project work?
items.answer: A logo project runs from briefing to concepts, then feedback rounds, and ends with final vector files (SVG/PDF/AI) and basic guidelines.

items.question: Can you update our existing brand?
items.answer: Yes. We refresh logo, color, typography and applications without breaking recognition.

items.question: Do you also make social templates?
items.answer: Yes. We create consistent templates for posts, stories and ads so your team can publish quickly and recognizably.

items.question: What is the difference between digital and print design?
items.answer: Print needs color space, resolution and trim margins; digital needs sharpness on screens and fast load times. We deliver both correctly, tailored to the channel.

items.question: Can you layout magazines or brochures?
items.answer: Yes. We create multi-page layouts in InDesign with grid, styles and prepress checks, ready for print or digital distribution.

items.question: Do you help with printing?
items.answer: Yes. We design and can print in small or large quantities — from business cards and stickers to flyers, posters and brochures — with proofs and coordination through delivery.

items.question: How many feedback rounds are included?
items.answer: Usually 2 to 3 structured rounds are included. Extra rounds are possible by agreement.

items.question: Do we get source files?
items.answer: Yes, within the agreed delivery. That can be AI, PSD or INDD, or an export pack — depending on what we agreed.

items.question: Can design and webdesign run together?
items.answer: Yes. We align brand design and UI systems so print and website form one whole.

items.question: Where can I learn more about Digital Design?
items.answer: More information is on /digital-design and via the Digital Design services in the menu.

items.question: Which marketing services do you offer?
items.answer: We offer AEO/GEO/SEO, content, social, ads, ecommerce growth, product listing, community management and data entry.

items.question: How do you build a marketing strategy?
items.answer: We build a strategy around goals, audience, positioning, channel mix, content pipeline and KPIs — practical and executable, not only on paper.

items.question: What is full-funnel marketing for you?
items.answer: Full-funnel runs from awareness (content and ads) through consideration (cases and SEO) to conversion (landing pages and CRM) and then retention, so every stage has a clear role.

items.question: Do you help with positioning?
items.answer: Yes. Clear positioning prevents fragmented campaigns and weak conversion.

items.question: Can you deliver content writing?
items.answer: Yes. We write blogs, website copy, newsletters, landing pages and sales copy — SEO- and conversion-focused.

items.question: Do you do ecommerce marketing?
items.answer: Yes. We work on product feeds, listing quality, CRO, ads and SEO for categories and products.

items.question: What is CRO?
items.answer: CRO is Conversion Rate Optimization: improving pages, funnels and UX so more visitors convert.

items.question: How do you report marketing results?
items.answer: We report through dashboards or reports with traffic, leads, sales, CPA/ROAS and learnings per channel, including what we do next.

items.question: Do you work with our internal marketing team?
items.answer: Yes. We can execute, spar or take over a specialist part, for example SEO only or ads only.

items.question: How quickly do you launch campaigns?
items.answer: After tracking and setup, campaigns often go live within 1 to 2 weeks. Content work runs in parallel so creatives and pages are ready on time.

items.question: Do you help with email marketing?
items.answer: Yes. We create flows, newsletters and copy. Integration with CRM or ecommerce is possible.

items.question: Is marketing a monthly contract?
items.answer: Retainers are common for ongoing growth. Projects such as an audit, redesign or launch can be one-off.

items.question: How do you prevent “busy marketing” without results?
items.answer: Every activity is tied to KPIs. Underperforming tactics are stopped or improved with data, so budget goes to what works.

items.question: Which social channels do you manage?
items.answer: We mainly manage LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook, and where relevant X or TikTok — based on audience, not hype.

items.question: What is included in social media management?
items.answer: Social media management covers strategy, content calendar, creation and scheduling, community replies, reporting and ongoing optimization.

items.question: Do you also create the visuals and videos?
items.answer: Yes, via media creation: stills, carousels, short-form video and templates.

items.question: How often do you post?
items.answer: That depends on channel and goals. Typically we post 3 to 5 times per week per core channel, with quality over volume.

items.question: Do you help with community management?
items.answer: Yes. We handle moderation, replies, DMs and reputation care according to the agreed tone of voice.

items.question: Can social and ads be combined?
items.answer: Yes. Organic content feeds ad creatives; ads scale what performs organically.

items.question: How do you measure social success?
items.answer: We measure reach, engagement, click-outs, leads and assisted conversions — not likes alone. That shows what truly contributes to growth.

items.question: Do you work with influencers?
items.answer: On request: selection, briefing and tracking. We focus on fit and measurable outcomes, not reach alone.

items.question: Can you support crisis communication?
items.answer: Yes. We use fast response protocols and align with your team so replies stay consistent and under control.

items.question: Do you help with LinkedIn for B2B thought leadership?
items.answer: Yes. We create personal and company content, carousels, cases and employee advocacy so expertise becomes visible.

items.question: Do you deliver a content calendar?
items.answer: Yes. We deliver a monthly or quarterly plan with themes, formats and deadlines.

items.question: What if we already have a social manager?
items.answer: Then we can specialize in creatives, ads or strategy, or support peak periods without replacing the existing team.

items.question: How quickly will we see growth on social?
items.answer: Consistency matters. Significant growth usually takes weeks to months; with ads support it often goes faster.

items.question: What support do you offer?
items.answer: We offer WordPress support, custom website support, tickets and live chat, maintenance, security, performance and incident response.

items.question: How do I reach support?
items.answer: Via contact, an appointment, tickets in the dashboard or live chat on the site. Urgent cases are marked as priority.

items.question: What is your response time?
items.answer: We aim for a fast first response, often within one business day. For critical downtime we respond faster. Exact SLAs are in the support packages.

items.question: Do you offer 24/7 monitoring?
items.answer: Yes, in relevant support and hosting packages: monitoring, backups and alerts so problems become visible earlier.

items.question: Can you remove malware?
items.answer: Yes — on WordPress as well as custom stacks — including hardening and aftercare so the site comes back clean and better protected.

items.question: Do you handle WordPress updates for us?
items.answer: Yes, via “Maintenance and updates”: core, plugins and themes, with backup and checks before and after we update.

items.question: Do you help with hosting problems?
items.answer: Yes. We diagnose, migrate or optimize hosting, VPS and domains until the site runs stably again.

items.question: What if my site is down?
items.answer: Report it as urgent. We restore where possible via backups, server checks and a hotfix, and keep you updated on status along the way.

items.question: Is there a client portal?
items.answer: Yes. Logged-in clients see dashboard, tickets, projects and where relevant CRM or invoices.

items.question: Can multiple teammates open tickets?
items.answer: Yes, depending on account roles (client, manager or admin).

items.question: What is included in Basic/Standard/Premium support?
items.answer: Higher packages cover more sites, faster follow-up and broader coverage (updates, malware, speed, SEO). Details are on the support pages.

items.question: Do you also help with non-technical questions?
items.answer: Yes, about services, billing and account. How deep we go technically depends on your package.

items.question: Can I upgrade support later?
items.answer: Yes. You can scale up when traffic, risk or team needs grow.

items.question: Do you only build WordPress sites?
items.answer: No. Besides WordPress we do custom webdesign in HTML/CSS/JS, PHP and Next.js — separate from the WordPress services.

items.question: What does Website Support include?
items.answer: Website Support covers design, development, maintenance, security, performance, backups or migration and API integrations for custom stacks.

items.question: Can you redesign an existing site?
items.answer: Yes. We do a UX/UI refresh, conversion improvements and technical modernization, without throwing everything away if that is not needed.

items.question: Do you work with Next.js?
items.answer: Yes. Next.js is ideal for fast, SEO-ready marketing sites and dashboards.

items.question: Do you also build PHP applications?
items.answer: Yes. We build portals and APIs, modernize legacy and harden performance and security.

items.question: How do you ensure mobile websites?
items.answer: We design mobile-first, build responsive layouts and test on common devices and browsers so the site works everywhere.

items.question: Is accessibility (a11y) included?
items.answer: We build with accessible baseline practices. Stricter WCAG programs can be included as extra scope.

items.question: Can you offer CMS options without WordPress?
items.answer: Yes. That can be a headless CMS, custom admin or a static setup — depending on your team and needs.

items.question: How long does a webdesign project take?
items.answer: Landing pages usually take a few weeks; larger sites or apps run in sprints over multiple weeks. Planning follows after intake.

items.question: Do you also handle copy and SEO at launch?
items.answer: Yes, combined with content and SEO services so the site goes live searchable and conversion-focused right away.

items.question: What about performance after launch?
items.answer: We optimize Core Web Vitals, caching or CDN and monitoring. Aftercare then continues via maintenance packages.

items.question: Can you connect APIs (CRM, payments, AI)?
items.answer: Yes. We build integrations with clean error handling, logging and documentation.

items.question: How do you deliver code?
items.answer: Where possible we deliver via repository and deploy pipeline, with environments (staging and production) and a clear handover.

items.question: Do you help with on-site conversion optimization?
items.answer: Yes. We run A/B tests, UX improvements, forms, CTAs and page speed so more visitors convert.

items.question: Which hosting do you offer?
items.answer: We offer shared hosting, WordPress hosting and VPS — in Basic, Plus and Business tiers — plus domains.

items.question: What is the difference between shared, WordPress and VPS?
items.answer: Shared is cost-effective for smaller sites. WordPress hosting is optimized for WP. VPS gives more resources and control for heavier loads.

items.question: Do you help with domain registration?
items.answer: Yes. We advise, register or transfer the domain and connect DNS correctly.

items.question: Is SSL included with hosting?
items.answer: Yes. SSL is standard in our relevant hosting plans.

items.question: Can you migrate my site to your hosting?
items.answer: Yes. We handle backup, migration, DNS cutover, SSL and smoke tests, with minimal downtime.

items.question: How do backups work on hosting?
items.answer: That depends on the plan: simple or automated backups. Extra off-site retention is available.

items.question: What if I get more traffic?
items.answer: Then we scale to Plus, Business or VPS and optimize caching and CDN so the site can handle the growth.

items.question: Do you offer email with domains?
items.answer: That depends on the package and setup. We advise reliable mail solutions and set DNS correctly (SPF, DKIM and DMARC).

items.question: How secure is your hosting?
items.answer: We use firewall, SSL, updates, monitoring and hardening. Extra security services can add more layers on top.

items.question: Can I move from shared to VPS later?
items.answer: Yes. We plan the migration together, including tests and rollback, so the switch stays controlled.

items.question: Do you support CDN?
items.answer: Yes, where relevant — often a free CDN is included in WP hosting plans — for faster global delivery.

items.question: What is your uptime approach?
items.answer: We monitor, respond quickly to incidents and communicate clearly around maintenance windows so you know what is happening.

items.question: Do you help solve DNS problems?
items.answer: Yes. We fix records, propagation, mail auth and domain connections until DNS is correct again.

items.question: How do I choose the right hosting plan?
items.answer: Based on traffic, stack (WordPress or custom), resources and growth. We advise honestly — we do not oversell.

items.question: Where can I see hosting prices?
items.answer: On the hosting service pages under Services → Webhosting and domains, with monthly or yearly options where applicable.
